name: happy-week
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original preschool achievement medal illustration. Center subject: a cheerful bear holding a small calendar of seven colorful empty tiles each with a tiny checkmark, no letters or numbers. Complete medal construction: gold rounded-square enamel badge, teal ribbon tails. Premium sculpted clay-toy 3D artwork, rounded plush-like forms, expressive friendly faces, tactile detail and polished enamel accents, soft warm studio light. Harmonious amber, cream, sage, teal, peach and lavender palette. Visually distinct central story and outer silhouette, readable at small icon size. Full medal and ribbon tails fully inside a square with 8% empty margins. Genuinely transparent background. No text, no letters, no digits, no logo, no rectangular presentation card.
